from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper and its outbound references to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper cites in its bibliography")
    cites_this_paper: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper — inferred from their reference lists, left empty here")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
